Keap lets you store critical information, including your contact’s phone number, email, address, as well as meeting histories, payments, invoices, conversations, emails and notes. You’ll be able to make every customer feel like an important individual, because that’s what they are. **How much does it cost to add more contacts?** Additional contact pricing is in tiers, with the cost per contact going down as you add larger quantities of contacts. It includes: - Business mapping session with an automation expert - Done-for-you automations - Proven Automation Templates - Data import - Migration services - Weekly, monthly and quarterly strategy calls with an expert - Integration of third-party tools **Why is a Keap implementation package required?** After over 20 years of helping small businesses implement software, we’ve seen that the businesses that have the most success and get the most value for their money are those who have strategy, support and services to help them implement the software. When companies fully execute, they experience game-changing results. Conversely, those who purchase the software with good intentions but don’t fully execute, fail to get results, and that doesn’t benefit anyone. We understand that no one likes a bigger price tag on their software, but this is one of those “you’ll thank us later” situations. The time and money you’ll save with a successful implementation will far exceed your investment in even the most robust implementation package we offer. - Free trial **Is the free trial experience limited or locked down in any way?** The free trial has most, but not all of the features in the paid edition. Limitations include an email sending limit of 25, no ability to process payments, and no ability to send or receive texts. The goal of the free trial is for you to experience what the software is like before you buy. When you’re ready to truly start using the software, it’s best to upgrade to a paid plan so you get all the features as well as the migration and implementation services, where we do most of the setup work for you. **Can I send email in my free trial?** Yes, however, there are two limitations: 1. **You must set up [DKIM authentication](https://help.keap.com/help/dkim) first.** This is due to industry-wide changes requiring DKIM authentication for all senders using an Email Marketing System (EMS) like Keap. 2. **You can send a maximum of 25 emails in a free trial.** This is a safeguard to limit abuse of free trial accounts by spammers. **Will I need a credit card to start the free trial?** No credit card is required for your [free trial](https://www.thryv.com/schedule-keap-demo/). Give it a try and find out first-hand how Keap helps serious entrepreneurs get organized, follow up and automate to create peace of mind, grow sales and free up time. - Billing **Can I cancel at any time?** Yes. However, if you’re on an annual contract, please be aware that you’ll be charged a $299 early termination fee if you cancel your subscription before the end of your one-year contract term. To cancel, initiate your cancellation request at least 10 days prior to the next invoice date by calling Customer Support at [1-866-800-0004 x2](tel:1-866-800-0004 x2) and talking to a Keap representative. **Are there separate fees for receiving customer payments with Keap?** Yes. Whether you use Keap Pay, or a third-party payment processor, each processor will charge their standard processing fee for each payment that is collected. The rates are the same as what you’d pay if not using Keap. [Learn more about payment processors](https://help.keap.com/help/merchant-accounts). When you accept payments with Keap Pay, our native processing solution, you get competitive rates plus complete visibility into all your transactions. This improves reporting and troubleshooting. - Support **What type of support do you provide?** With Keap, you’ll receive call-in support from our U.S.-based customer support team during business hours Monday-Friday, and 24/7 online chat support. You can also reach out to your Customer Success Manager for help with strategy and finding the resources you need. Plus, you have free access to [Thryv Academy’s](https://academy.keap.com/) live training events and online learning platform, which includes an extensive library of courses, videos and webinars on building business automations within Keap. - Security **Is Keap secure?** Absolutely. Keap has developed stringent information security risk management policies to ensure confidentiality, integrity and availability of your data. To learn more about Keap’s data security [click here](https://keap.com/legal/data-security). - Text Marketing **What is Text Marketing?** Text Marketing includes one-to-one text messages, automated text messaging, text broadcasts and individual replies from broadcast messages, plus a toll-free marketing number that helps you efficiently reach your leads and clients. It’s currently only available in the U.S. **How much do text messages cost?** Tier 1 (500 messages and 100 voice minutes) is included with your Keap subscription, and you may upgrade to higher tiers at any time, starting at $24/month. # Keap CRM Review and Pricing
### Table of Contents
Compared to other products on the market, we found that Keap’s CRM offers exceptionally powerful and user-friendly automation features, with readily available templates, an intuitive drag-and-drop automation builder, and a collection of AI-powered, cross-functional workflows designed for generating new leads, increasing conversions and driving [customer loyalty](https://www.business.com/articles/what-makes-customer-loyalty-so-important/). It provides numerous top-tier services to help companies manage their business and customers with ease, while remaining straightforward, intuitive and easily scalable.

## Keap Pricing
### Sample Pricing
| **Number of users** | **Rate (billed annually)** |
|-|-|
| 2 | $249 per month |
| 5 | $345 per month |
| 10 | $505 per month |
| 15 | $665 per month |
| 20 | $825 per month |

### Additional Costs
- **Additional users:** Each extra user will cost $35 per month.
- **Additional contacts:** Extra contacts are sold in progressive bundles (2,500; 4,000; 6,500; 11,500; 16,500; 26,500; and 50,000-plus). Pricing increases as your database grows. For example, if you had 15 users and wanted 6,500 contacts, you’d pay $785 per month (billed annually). We found this surprising, as most competitors offer volume discounts. If you need more than 50,000 contacts, you’ll need to contact Keap sales.
- **Onboarding fee**: A one-time $500 onboarding and implementation fee is required.
- **Free trial:** Keap offers a 14-day free trial with access to most features.

### Included Features
- Contact, deal and task management
- Reminders
- Easy and advanced workflow automations
- Business analytics and reports
- Sales pipelines
- Business phone line and text messaging
- Appointments, quotes and invoices
- Customizable dashboards
- Internal and external forms
- One-click upsell and cross-sell
- Billing automation
- Subscription management

Marketing features include:

- Email campaigns and templates
- Lead source tracking
- Landing page builder

Compared to other products on the market, we found that Keap’s CRM offers exceptionally powerful and user-friendly automation features, with readily available templates, an intuitive drag-and-drop automation builder, and a collection of AI-powered, cross-functional workflows designed for generating new leads, increasing conversions and driving [customer loyalty](https://www.business.com/articles/what-makes-customer-loyalty-so-important/). ## Why We Chose Keap as the Best CRM Software for Sales Automation

Unlike many of the other top CRMs we reviewed, Keap offers two tiers of sales automation options: easy and advanced. Business owners who want to set up straightforward “when-then” workflows to gather website leads, follow up with prospects, schedule appointments, send automated notifications and emails, and create deals based on set conditions can choose from a variety of ready-made, customizable templates or build their own in just a few clicks.

Even though advanced automations give users the option to go much deeper and set up alternative decision paths, delay timers and complex conditions, creating [workflow automations](https://www.business.com/articles/workflow-automation/) can be done on a highly visual canvas with a simple drag-and-drop process. The platform also includes an AI automation assistant, which provides dozens of templated bundles that you can preview, modify and test — all without leaving one consolidated view.

All in all, Keap stands out from the competition with its ease of use, various thematic templates and modification options, and numerous available integrations, making it our best pick for a CRM focused on sales automation.

![Keap project pipeline](https://www.business.com/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.business.com%2Fapp%2Fuploads%2F2018%2F02%2F12081128%2Fkeap-project-pipeline-1024x473.png&w=2048&q=80)_Keap allows users to view and manage multiple pipelines across sales, marketing and operations. A CRM can help you collect and analyze [customer feedback](https://www.business.com/articles/how-to-use-customer-feedback/) by tracking each client interaction and turning that data into actionable insights.

## Ease of Use

Keap CRM is simple enough for beginners but flexible enough to handle the advanced capabilities more experienced users need. We particularly liked the following ease-of-use features.

- **Intuitive interface:** Your [sales team](https://www.business.com/articles/how-to-build-a-sales-team/) will appreciate that Keap’s tools are clearly labeled and easy to find. Most features include a helpful overview tour and walkthrough video the first time they’re used, which helps users get up to speed faster. We also like that users can complete most tasks, including setting appointments, managing email and text conversations, sending invoices and adding automations, without leaving the contact view. Other CRMs we evaluated often open new tabs or views for these updates, so we found Keap’s approach neater and more efficient.
- **Easy AI assistant functionality:** We like that Keap’s AI assistant helps streamline campaigns, optimize email communication, generate tailored marketing content and build automation workflows that support the entire customer lifecycle.
- **Onboarding and implementation assistance:** All Keap users get access to onboarding checklists, online courses, videos, webinars and other training resources, plus personalized advice from Keap’s expert coaches and 24/7 chat support. The required implementation package accelerates adoption and ensures employees understand how to use the platform effectively. It supports initial data migration, automation and integration setup, and provides a year of strategic assistance to keep the system performing optimally. Once onboarding is complete, Keap’s customer support team remains available for troubleshooting and guidance.
- **Easy integrations:** Keap connects with Google and Microsoft 365 suites, as well as core apps like Zoom, QuickBooks, HelloSign and Mailchimp. Additional integrations are available through Zapier or in the Keap Marketplace. These require no coding experience and extend functionality with automations for services like SurveyMonkey, Calendly and Facebook Lead Ads. Small businesses can also use the Marketplace to connect with external Keap experts for extra implementation support or marketing and sales guidance.

Did You Know?Did you know

You can use the CRM's integrations to trigger events like automatically recording payments or creating a new contact based on lead behavior. Some Keap Marketplace connectors are free, while others require a monthly fee or a one-time license purchase.

## Keap Features

There are key [CRM features](https://www.business.com/articles/features-to-look-for-in-crm/) to look out for when you’re shopping for the right platform to support your sales team. These are the ones that make Keap stand out.

### Sales Automation

Keap’s sales automation features are stellar. You can choose to set up easy or advanced workflows, with both options offering a generous selection of customizable templates to power up your [lead generation](https://www.business.com/articles/how-to-generate-more-sales-leads/), drive customer loyalty and even help nominate an Employee of the Month.

- **Easy automations:** Easy automations work off the basic “when-then” formula and are best suited for businesses that rely on constant communication with their customers. For example, you can follow up on an unpaid invoice after a set period, send a reminder about an upcoming appointment or notify a team member about a new form submission.
- **Advanced automations:** Advanced automations allow users to set up alternative paths based on specific conditions and scenarios. For instance, you can establish rules for asking your top clients for reviews and promptly follow up with any unsatisfied customers.

We love that, thanks to AI-powered automation “plays,” you can launch and automate entire multi-channel campaigns to support [customer journeys](https://www.business.com/articles/small-business-customer-journey-map/). The AI will suggest optimal topics and content for each step and help you customize messages to fit a certain tone of voice. It can also translate them — a particularly helpful feature for small businesses looking to expand into international markets.

We also appreciate that you can automate most of your sales processes. You can create and share custom price quotes from the Keap app, and clients can accept them online. Once accepted, your sales team can be notified via text message so they can convert the quote into an order customers can pay online. You can also use the platform’s [sales pipeline management](https://www.business.com/articles/crm-pipeline-management/) tools for lightweight project management across your sales, marketing and operations teams. We particularly like that Keap’s AI provides suggested workflows based on natural language prompts.

TipBottom line

Use the Notes shortcut at the bottom left of the advanced automations canvas to record the workflow's [target audience](https://www.business.com/articles/identify-your-target-audience/), goal or call to action. This information will help when onboarding new team members or ensuring the processes are well-maintained if you're away from the office.

### Integrated Email Builder

Keap offers a drag-and-drop tool and templates that make creating and managing [email marketing campaigns](https://www.business.com/articles/how-to-write-email-marketing-campaign/) quick and painless. Its automated sales correspondence helps prevent communication gaps and keeps deals moving forward. The broadcasting feature lets you send email blasts to segmented audiences, accelerating outreach while ensuring messages stay relevant. Pairing email templates and automation with built-in list segmentation tools improves the likelihood of lead conversion by making sure tailored messages reach the right recipient at the right time.

We were impressed by Keap AI’s content-generation capabilities. In addition to offering a wide range of customizable templates, it can work from natural language prompts to create tailored messages, then modify, shorten or translate them as needed. When designing emails for broadcasts, the AI assistant can also suggest optimal calls to action and headings, proofread copy, and help refine your message, streamlining email marketing and freeing your team to focus on closing.

### Built-in E-Commerce Automation

While many CRMs can manage aspects of e-commerce, most require third-party integrations to do so — but not Keap. This system includes built-in automated e-commerce functions, making it a viable choice for businesses that live and breathe online.

Keap lets you create quotes, send invoices with direct payment links, connect bank details to receive payments, add promo codes, set tax rates and build custom checkout forms for your website — all without leaving the app. You can also set up linked automations to pursue [upselling and cross-selling](https://www.business.com/articles/quick-tips-for-upselling-and-cross-selling/) opportunities at checkout or to save time chasing overdue payments. To help drive more leads, Keap lets you create custom landing pages and contact forms or use one of many predesigned templates.

You can set up recurring payments in Keap, which is particularly useful if you sell on a [subscription business model](https://www.business.com/articles/industries-that-take-full-advantage-of-the-subscription-business-model/).

### Contact Management

Like many CRMs, Keap has a dedicated section to store businesses and contacts. Each customer profile contains detailed records, including contact details, associated deals, and your previous sales interactions and communications.

What sets Keap apart is the array of actions you can take straight from the contact card, without opening multiple tabs or navigating to a separate CRM area. You can create tasks, schedule appointments, send emails and record payments via handy pop-ups that don’t interrupt your flow. You can also add contacts directly to automation workflows, ensuring each lead is actioned immediately and nothing falls through the cracks.

Custom data fields let you focus on information critical to your business, rather than manipulating preset fields that may be irrelevant. We also like that, unlike many other CRMs, Keap lets you add new custom fields, tags or values directly from the editing form rather than the admin panel, eliminating unnecessary admin steps.

![Keap customer info](https://www.business.com/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.business.com%2Fapp%2Fuploads%2F2022%2F08%2F01033907%2Fkeap-customer-information.png&w=1920&q=80)_Keap can show detailed customer information and all communication records at a glance. Source: Keap_

### Dedicated Business Line

All Keap users get access to a free business phone number for calls and texts, along with the option to set up voicemails and auto-reply messages. The number is connected to your smartphone, and the caller ID clearly indicates when a call is coming from a business contact. The business line is connected to both mobile and desktop versions of the CRM, making it easy to keep all conversations in one place, attach files to your messages, set up appointments and more.

We were particularly impressed by Keap’s ability to set up tasks from individual messages, ensuring no customer request or opportunity falls through the cracks. We also like that you can create message templates to streamline communication and reduce admin work.

TipBottom line

Currently, it's only possible to have one business line per user. However, you can set up call forwarding for up to five phone numbers to receive calls from the [business phone number](https://www.business.com/articles/need-a-business-phone-number-but-not-a-business-phone/), making it a good solution for small sales teams.

## Keap Pricing

Unlike most CRMs we reviewed, which offer tiered plans with different features, Keap charges based on the number of users and contacts in your account. The more users or contacts you add, the more you’ll pay.

### Sample Pricing

| 10 | $505 per month |
| 15 | $665 per month |
| 20 | $825 per month |

### Additional Costs

Take the following into account when figuring out pricing:

- **Additional users:** Each extra user will cost $35 per month.
- **Additional contacts:** Extra contacts are sold in progressive bundles (2,500; 4,000; 6,500; 11,500; 16,500; 26,500; and 50,000-plus). Pricing increases as your database grows. For example, if you had 15 users and wanted 6,500 contacts, you’d pay $785 per month (billed annually). We found this surprising, as most competitors offer volume discounts. If you need more than 50,000 contacts, you’ll need to contact Keap sales.
- **Onboarding fee**: A one-time $500 onboarding and implementation fee is required.
- **Free trial:** Keap offers a 14-day free trial with access to most features.

### Included Features

All Keap users get equal access to its CRM, marketing, sales, operations and administrative tools. The core CRM and sales-specific features include:

- Contact, deal and task management
- Reminders
- Easy and advanced workflow automations
- Business analytics and reports
- Sales pipelines
- Business phone line and text messaging
- Appointments, quotes and invoices
- Customizable dashboards
- Internal and external forms
- One-click upsell and cross-sell
- Billing automation
- Subscription management

Marketing features include:

- Email campaigns and templates
- Lead source tracking
- Landing page builder

The platform also provides user role management, calendar sync, a built-in Zapier integration and a mobile app.

Keap’s business line feature supports both business text messages and voice calls, so its messaging plans include a bundle of texts and voice minutes. All users start on Tier 1, which includes 500 free text messages, 100 free minutes and a toll-free phone number.

## Implementation and Onboarding

Keap does a good job of ensuring its customers start strong and continue to succeed.

- **Online and self-help resources:** Keap’s onboarding checklists and quick in-app video walkthroughs for key features complement its how-to video library and detailed knowledge base, helping you [set up your CRM for success](https://www.business.com/articles/small-business-crm-success/) from the start. Together, these resources explain how to connect lead sources, create workflow automations, track activities, set up invoicing and payments, design and send email campaigns, and manage customer communication.
- **Implementation package:** Keap’s required implementation package, priced at $500, provides business owners with access to a team of Keap experts and includes contact import services and migration from select platforms (up to 15 hours). It also offers a dedicated Implementation Strategy Manager who will help set up the CRM to match your business goals and check in regularly to keep you on course. This package can be complemented with separate paid add-ons like e-commerce data import or email list cleaning.
- **Enhanced coaching:** The Keap Expert Coaching service offers personalized one-on-one support, training webinars, and a custom sales and marketing plan to help you [convert more leads](https://www.business.com/articles/9-steps-to-lead-conversion-success/). After clarifying your business goals, the coach works with you to develop an action plan for growing sales and encouraging [repeat business](https://www.business.com/articles/5-ways-to-earn-repeat-business/). The service is available to all users for a one-time $499 fee.
- **Ongoing growth support:** Keap offers three monthly membership plans, ranging from $99 to $1,997 per month. In addition to premium support and regular strategy calls, the top-tier plans include personalized automation services and list cleaning.

TipBottom line

Keap offers a collection of free "Play Blueprints" to walk you through the most common [sales processes](https://www.business.com/articles/sales-process/), from an action plan and goals to implementation and relevant metrics.

## Customer Service

Keap’s customer support options include email and 24/7 live chat access, as well as a community forum and Keap Academy, an online learning platform with an extensive collection of how-to videos, courses and on-demand webinars.

Phone support is available Monday through Friday for businesses in the U.S., Monday through Saturday for those in the U.K., and Monday through Saturday for companies in Australia. All users also get access to a dedicated Keap Customer Success Manager who can help resolve issues, provide resources and offer expert business advice along the way.

To test the quality of Keap’s customer support, we contacted the vendor as a small business owner interested in its software. The representative we spoke with was knowledgeable and helpful, describing each feature in detail and reminding us that the support team would be available every step of the way if we needed assistance. They also discussed common challenges small businesses face with CRM software and how Keap’s CRM addresses them. The rep was extremely patient, offering to call us back and set up a demo to help us understand every aspect of the software.

In contrast, the in-app chat option was less effective, with wait times exceeding 30 minutes — a significant drawback in our experience.

## Limitations

Here are a few potential concerns about Keap:

- **Limited analytics**: We found Keap’s data analytics functionality somewhat limited, especially when it comes to sales enablement and revenue forecasting. While the software offers detailed reports on conversions and campaign performance, businesses looking for deeper team management insights, custom reporting or AI-powered predictions might prefer a solution more tailored to sales management. We’d recommend reading our [review of Freshworks’ Freshsales CRM](https://www.business.com/reviews/freshworks-crm/) in that case.
- **Not as customizable:** Companies with unique or complex needs may find that Keap lacks the deep customization options and business app integrations they need to manage fluctuating sales circumstances. The Keap Expert Coaching service is ideal for this type of situation, though, and can guide you on how to optimize the system for atypical use cases and set up complex automations that adapt to your business needs. Still, our [Salesforce CRM review](https://www.business.com/reviews/salesforce-crm-software/) presents an alternative option for businesses most interested in customization.
- **Expensive texting:** While Keap includes 500 free text messages and 100 call minutes with all subscriptions, higher-tier text marketing packages can be costly. If your sales team heavily relies on texts and phone calls, you may need to factor in up to $279 per month in extra costs. Businesses outside the U.S. and Canada should also note that a dedicated phone line and one-on-one text messages are not available to them.

## Methodology

This review is based on our extensive research comparing dozens of the [best CRM software](https://www.business.com/categories/crm-software/) solutions on the market, along with a detailed product review process that included comprehensive communication with the platform’s customer support team, a trial to evaluate the product’s functionality, and an examination of numerous tutorials, webinars, demos and support materials. As part of the review, we took a close look at Keap’s features and functionality, including contact and deal management, sales automation, reporting and analytics, e-commerce capabilities, email marketing and integrations. We also factored in pricing and setup. We chose Keap as the best CRM for sales automation because of its powerful automation tools, user-friendly workflows and breadth of prebuilt templates that make it easy for businesses to streamline sales processes from lead capture to close.

## Keap FAQs

### Is Infusionsoft the same as Keap?

Open accordion

Infusionsoft was renamed Keap in 2019 to better represent the provider's evolving brand. The former Infusionsoft functionality is still available in the Keap app, where it has been preserved and enhanced.

### Is there a free version of Keap?

Open accordion

No, Keap doesn't have a free plan. However, it offers a 14-day free trial (with no credit card required), which should provide enough time to evaluate the CRM's suitability for your business.

### Is Keap being sold to Thryv?

Open accordion

Keap was acquired by Thryv, a sales and marketing platform focused on small businesses, in 2024. The acquisition had no immediate effect on existing Keap users, but the two companies are reportedly working on developing new collaborative products.

## Bottom Line

We recommend Keap CRM for …

- Companies with many repetitive processes that would benefit from straightforward and advanced sales and marketing automations.
- E-commerce businesses looking to automate lead collection, payment processing and basic client communication.
- Sales teams that need personalized onboarding and implementation support.

We _don’t_ recommend Keap CRM for …

- Small businesses and startups that don’t require advanced feature sets designed for large teams.
- Businesses with large contact databases but little room in the budget for upfront fees.
- Businesses that require highly advanced analytics, AI-driven sales forecasting or deep customization beyond Keap’s available options.
